_comment: Words exempt from the structured parameter-naming convention (param_naming.json).
Typed alone as the feature in the Dimension Value name stepper, one of these adds
a 'None' choice to the type step: the parameter is then named just the word
('Width') — no owner, no type — and so lands at the top level of the Parameters
window (it doesn't parse, so it isn't filed under any component's group).
Matched case-insensitively; the spelling here is the one used. Edited from
